# FactoryJet Technologies

> AI-Native Web Design, E-Commerce Development, and AI Agent Development Agency serving UK, US, UAE, and India.

## About

FactoryJet Technologies is an AI-native digital agency founded and led by Bhavesh Barot, based in Bengaluru, India. We serve SMBs across the United Kingdom, United States, United Arab Emirates, and India. We deliver high-performance websites, e-commerce stores, AI agents, and AI SEO at 50-60% below typical agency rates with a 7-day delivery model.

## Services

- Web Design & Development (Next.js, React, WordPress, Webflow, Framer)
- E-Commerce Development (Shopify, WooCommerce, headless commerce)
- AI Agent Development (custom agentic AI, multi-agent systems, MCP integration)
- AI SEO, GEO, AEO, AIO (Generative Engine Optimisation, Answer Engine Optimisation)
- Shopify Development (Shopify Plus, Shopify themes, migrations)
